name: Labcorp
notes: Researched from public labcorp.com pages and public Labcorp Patient help-center answers (no sign-in). Pay in the Labcorp Patient portal or MyLabcorp app, as a guest (8-digit invoice number plus the ZIP code and date of birth on the invoice), by phone at 800-845-6167 any time, by mail to P.O. Box 2240, Burlington, NC 27216-2240, by QR code or at patient service center kiosks. Labcorp lists major credit cards, HSA cards, PayPal, Google Pay and Apple Pay; bank/eCheck is not stated (the engine contract requires bank, so it is kept as a family default). No payment service fee when paying Labcorp directly. Payment plans can be set up online in the portal/app. AutoPay and paperless are not described publicly, so both are left to the family defaults. The user ID is the email address used to register; codes go by text or email (registration/password reset). Payments post in 24-48 hours.

help.title: Ways to pay your Labcorp bill
paragraphs: Pay in the Labcorp Patient portal or the MyLabcorp app, or use guest bill pay without signing in. Guest pay needs the 8-digit invoice number plus the ZIP code and date of birth that match the invoice.

Online, Labcorp takes major credit cards and HSA cards, plus PayPal, Google Pay and Apple Pay. Paying Labcorp directly carries no payment service fee; Labcorp is not tied to invoice-payment services such as Doxo and is not responsible for their fees.

You can also pay by phone at 800-845-6167 at any hour, scan the QR code on your bill, use a kiosk at a patient service center, or mail a check or money order with the bill stub to Labcorp, P.O. Box 2240, Burlington, NC 27216-2240. Write the invoice number on the check and do not send cash.
Payments take 24 to 48 hours to update your balance. If it has not changed after 48 hours, call Patient Billing.

help.title: Payment plans
paragraphs: Set up a payment plan in the MyLabcorp app, in the Labcorp Patient portal, at a patient service center, or by calling Patient Billing at 800-845-6167, weekdays 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern.

help.title: Financial help and estimates
paragraphs: The LabAccess Partnership program serves uninsured patients and those whose plans do not cover lab testing: bring the test request to a patient service center and pay the discounted rate in full at the visit. Outstanding Labcorp charges must be settled to stay eligible.
Uninsured and self-pay patients can request a Good Faith Estimate before the visit, in the portal, while scheduling, or from the Clinical Contact Center at 800-762-4344.

help.title: Insurance questions and disputes
paragraphs: Insurance claims can take 4 to 6 weeks to process. If you think a bill is wrong, send a copy of your Explanation of Benefits with your Labcorp invoice number by fax to 866-227-2939 or by mail to the Burlington P.O. Box.

help.title: Your Labcorp Patient account
paragraphs: Register from the portal or the MyLabcorp app with Create an Account. The email address you enter becomes your user ID, and Labcorp verifies you with a code sent by text or email that is valid for 20 minutes.
Changing your email under contact preferences changes where notices go, not your user ID; keep signing in with the original email.
